status: Committed before implementation, new training, and new outcome inspection. Numerical debugging on nonstudy seeds is permitted and will be labeled; any protocol amendments must be separately timestamped and disclosed.

primary_study.model: Accepted multistage quadratic service control with nonsmooth tree switching, two service coordinates, six coupled resource channels, nonconstant outside protocol, node boundaries and additional capacity rows. No single-price star reduction.
primary_study.context: Six independent resource-reward shifts uniformly on the integer grid [-16,16]/16 and positive switching friction uniformly on [2,32]/64. Exact primitive generation is committed in executable sources before study execution.
models: same scalar critic with value-and-resource-gradient labels
primary_study.selection_rule: None. Retain all eight independent fits and their independently generated deployment cohorts. No seed or method selection using deployment results.
primary_study.primary_endpoint: Paired cohort-mean unrefined regret, gradient-supervised minus value-only neural critic; training/cohort pair is the replication unit.
classical_baselines: cached OSQP full problem, cold iterates
cached OSQP full problem, previous-context warm start
cached base-response solver with predicted resource prices
primary_study.timing_rule: Charge prediction, feasible repair, dual certificate, and every actual fallback solve and second audit. Record setup and label/fitting costs separately. Certification is identical across learned and classical candidates. No speed claim unless complete measured pipeline supports it.

structural_and_stress_tests.scope: Independent heterogeneous primitives, vector decisions, nonconstant comparators, endogenous switching signs, multiple capacities; arbitrary-price certificate and derivative-response identities, with small-instance independent optimization cross-checks.

star_reassessment.source: Unchanged R14 accepted-star primitives and exact structural solvers
strata: high resource rewards activating root capacity
star_reassessment.report: Preserve all strata, zero-gain cases, unfavorable seeds and original R14 observations. Report nearest breakpoint, active/saturated leaves, root binding, gate activation, unrefined regret and certification rates.

inference.paired_intervals: Student intervals across independent training/deployment pairs; explicitly state the approximate distributional interpretation and separate from exact certificate validity.
inference.frozen_policy_bounds: Simultaneous bounded-variable bounds conditional on all fitted policies using genuinely untouched deployment contexts; disclose any vacuous lower bound. Use deterministic analytic range bounds, not empirical maxima.
inference.procedure_claim: Do not conflate conditional frozen-policy guarantees with distribution-free reliability over training randomness. Repeated-train cohort results directly measure both sources of variability.
inference.provenance: R14 seed-14999 validation is held-out internal validation, not externally preregistered validation. R15 uses this prior remote protocol commit.

preservation: No predecessor scientific source, observation or review will be deleted. Exact R14 root files are snapshotted; relocations have a mapping. Main and review branches remain unchanged.
publication: Ordinary TeX, runnable sources, generated tables and raw outcomes, compiled main and companion manuscripts, point-by-point R14 response, checksums, and a read-only validation check on the final reviewable commit.
